# `browser-tab journal`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab journal [FLAGS]`

Show recorded focus/navigation history

## Flags

### `--view [view]`

Which journal view to show

**Choices:**

- `windowMru`
- `tabMru`
- `journey`
- `recent`

### `--browser <name>`

Restrict to one browser

### `--window <id>`

Window handle (required for tabMru)

### `--tab <id>`

Tab handle (required for journey)

### `--limit <n>`

Max records
